rules.statement: The respondent, being the executor of a will and having been prohibited by an order from drawing more than Rs. 22,000 without permission, disobeyed this order by withdrawing Rs. 52,000, which constitutes contempt of court.
rules.supporting_quote: Held , that disobedience of the order of the District Court amounted to contempt of its authority.

meta.parties: In the Matter of A Rule Under Section 51 of the Courts Ordinance, No. 1 of 1889, On Alexander Francis Molamure Executor of the Last Will and Testament of the Late J. W. Maduwanwala
